[[Mysterious Armor Pieces]] can be used to change a single [[hero]]'s armor set to the hero-only [[Mysterious armor]]. To change a hero's armor, speak to [[Mureh]] in [[The Shadow Nexus (outpost)|The Shadow Nexus]] while that hero is in your party.

Only [[Nightfall]] [[hero]]es who do not have [[Ancient armor]] or [[Elite Sunspear armor]] available to them are eligible for this armor:

*[[General Morgahn]]
*[[Goren]]
*[[Norgu]]
*[[Olias]]
*[[Zenmai]]

==Acquisition==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**[[The Shadow Nexus]]
***[[Margonite Portal Mage]]
:::<small>''Item has a very small chance to be placed directly in each player's inventory each time a Portal Mage is killed.''</small>

==Notes==
*Once a hero has been given at least one alternate set of armor, you can switch between any of their unlocked sets at any [[hero armorer]]s corresponding to that hero.
*A hero must be wearing one of their alternate armor sets to be displayed in the [[Monument of Fellowship]] in the [[Hall of Monuments]].
